name: io.github.jayjodev/vivory-mcp-verification
title: Vivory Verification Gateway
description: Umbrella MCP server bundling 27 verification tools across 9 categories — claim verification, DOI resolution, web archive lookup (Wayback + archive.today), reproducibility hash registry, C2PA / PDF / hash-chain / AI-watermark provenance, peer-review verdicts, forecast track record, SEC EDGAR filings, GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier resolution. Single MCP registration for AI agents that need to prove what's real.

environmentVariables.name: VIVORY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Vivory Pro API key for higher daily limits (10,000/day Pro vs 100/day anonymous). Get one at api.vivory.app/dashboard/api-keys.

environmentVariables.name: VIVORY_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the upstream gateway URL (default: https://api.vivory.app/api). Useful for self-hosted Vivory backends.
